name: Statue of Liberty
source: USGS CMGP Post-Sandy New York City lidar (NAVD88 metres). USGS 3DEP public-domain lidar, Entwine Point Tiles: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/NY_NewYorkCity/ept.json
facts: The Statue of Liberty was a gift of friendship from the people of France to the United States.
Her skin is copper, about as thick as two pennies. She started out brown like a penny and took about thirty years to turn green.
axes: +X east, +Y up, +Z south; metres = int16 * scale; y = 0 is the water level
order: random (the first N points are an even subsample)
